title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Fewer kids waiting, more kids moving
hook: At your next practice, count the kids standing in line.
intro: Eleven kids stand in line and wait.
statement: Kids learn by doing, not by watching a line.
q1: Do you split into small groups at every station —
q2: or keep one line so you can watch every rep?
q3: How long can your youngest players really wait?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But practice moves
t2: when more kids get more touches.
cta: Coaches — how do you keep lines short?
ctaLines: Two lines. Small groups. A parent at each station.
One watched rep or five unwatched ones?
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
At your next practice, count the kids standing in line.
One kid takes a turn. Eleven kids wait.
Kids learn by doing, not by watching.
Small groups mean more touches. One line means you see every rep. There is no perfect answer.
How do you keep your lines short? Share your habit in the comments.
